text:
The heart is the organ that pumps blood.

In the narrative, the melody serves as the rhythmic pulse of the community, much like the heart’s steady beat sustains life. Just as blood circulates through veins to connect every part of the body, the haunting lullaby flows through the streets, connecting disparate lives into a single, breathing entity. The whistler, the radio, and the bell are not merely sounds; they are the systole and diastole of the town’s collective soul, ensuring that no one is left in the cold silence of isolation. The motif binds them together, proving that while individual stories may vary, the shared rhythm of memory and peace keeps the community alive.
